description: Review of every entry of the KNJA catalog (https://knja.net/catalog.json, downloaded 2026-11-26, 478 entries). The list was used only as a research pointer: no wording, selection or metadata of it is served. Wording of adopted quotations comes from the cited original text. Reasons for 'not_suitable' were assigned in a keyword-assisted first pass after every entry had been read; entries without a clear single reason are 'low_editorial_value'.
